$comment: Rift lifecycle fixture (#196). NOT CONTENT: it lives outside content/ so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, and nothing ships it. Its chapter ids are placeholders with no files behind them. It shows every rift property at least once - single-use + timed + hidden destination, triggered + one-way, a linked two-way pair with shared uses, an unstable flicker that collapses, and a persistent triggered bridge - on a map that can always still be finished. rifts.test.ts walks it; tools/content/campaign-graph-schema.test.mjs holds it to the schema. docs/campaigns/graph-campaigns.md (Rifts) walks through it.
title: The Rift Lifecycle
blurb: A camp, a shore, a drowned isle, sunken ruins and a glass spire, joined by rifts that open, flicker, run out and close. Not a story: a map of every kind of rift.

shore.$comment: Its chapter may send the tide out (sets tide_out), and a replay may bring it back in.
shore.title: The Shore

camp-to-isle.$comment: Single-use, timed and hidden: open from the start for four moves, crossable once, and nobody knows where it goes until they have been.
camp-to-isle.label: Step into the shimmer

camp-to-ruins.$comment: One mouth of the twin gate: wakes once the party has found the ruins, and the pair shares two crossings.
camp-to-ruins.label: Through the twin gate

shore-to-ruins.$comment: Triggered and one-way: there only while the tide is out, and no rift leads back.
shore-to-ruins.label: Walk the tide-rift down to the ruins

isle-to-spire.$comment: Persistent and triggered: once the ruins are done the lantern bridge lights, and stays lit.
isle-to-spire.label: Cross the lantern bridge

ruins-to-camp.$comment: The twin gate's other mouth: crossing either counts for both.
ruins-to-camp.label: Through the twin gate

ruins-to-spire.$comment: Unstable: there on odd visits to the ruins, gone on even ones, and it collapses behind the first party through.
ruins-to-spire.label: Climb the flickering stair
